reviews.review:
With every update the game gets easier and easier up to the point were I feel like the dev team is holding my wee wee for me while I try and pee. Haven't played in months but tried the "newest hardest difficulty" with some buddies who also haven't played in months. We flew through act 1 and 2 like it was nothing, got bored, and quit again. Can't wait for another 6 months for them to add a house you can explore on the trail and new variant of existing enemies!!

edit: I tried the other dlcs months ago and just like before, equally easy and boring just like before. I had a feeling this was gonna be abandoned just like what they did with evolve and it happened, the devs have said they will no longer support this game and they still are selling it for $60 on here not including dlc, LOL. This game is officially Left 4 Dead.

After playing this game on and off for the past few months, my personal opinion is that you should avoid it. While fun at first, the game offers nothing truly unique, and much of the campaign feels repetitive, with you revisiting the same maps multiple times, while you shoot at the same 9 mutations and regular zombies, which feel more like cannon fodder, than anything challenging or interesting. Speaking of the campaign! What. A. BORE! I'm not lying when I tell you that I cannot remember a single thing about the campaign while playing. I felt like I had no real motive, or drive. No worthwhile goal that I was trying to achieve, as I paved the streets with zombie guts. Even the characters you play as, feel boring. I never felt like I got to understand who I was playing as. What was their backstory? How had they survived up to this point in the apocalypse? Ect. I just had no idea who I was, or what I was trying to accomplish. The best way to describe the campaign I would say, is that It felt empty and dull. 

I've not even gotten into the bots that you are FORCED to play with by the way. That's right! Forced. There is no true single player experience in this game, for those that want to be a single person army. And believe me when I tell you, those bots are dumber than a bag of lemons. They will actively run into your line of fire, and block your vision. Sometimes if you're extra lucky, you'll be pinned by a mutation zombie, and that bot which is stood an arms reach from you, won't set you free until you're downed. Not a good experience. On the other hand though, the bots can sometimes be pretty accurate with their guns....too accurate. They will snipe zombies and mutations with pin-point accuracy with their crappy SMG or pistal or whatever, leaving you to wonder if its actually you playing the game, or them.

There is much more I could say about this game, but I'm not about to write an article. To finish off, i'll briefly discuss the positives of this game, because despite what I have said, this game does have some. Firstly, is graphics. The game looks great, and the the animations are fantastic. Secondly, the gun play. Which is also stellar......that's it. I honestly cannot think of anything else positive to say about this game. 

If there is anything to take away from my review, it is that this is simply my own opinion of the experience I have had. An experience which will may be very different from yours, if you're someone reading this that is tempted to purchase this game. So read some more reviews, get a better understanding for what you may like or dislike about the game, because at the end of the day, you may love this game....you'd be an idiot....but you may love it regardless. 

Right! I'm done. You can leave now. Good day. Fairwell. Love you lots <3
